sloka: भक्ताः चैव अनुरक्ताः च हिताः च मम नित्यशः ।हन्यमाना अपि न हन्यन्ते न न कुर्युः वचो मम ॥३-२१-३॥
transliteration: bhaktāḥ caiva anuraktāḥ ca hitāḥ ca mama nityaśaḥ ।hanyamānā api na hanyante na na kuryuḥ vaco mama ॥3-21-3॥

translations.english: They are loyal and faithful to me. They are always my wellwishers. Even when attacked, they cannot be killed. They never fail to carry out my orders.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उन राक्षसा को ओर शूर्पनखा को वहाँ देख, तेजस्वी लक्ष्मण से कहा
